title: Music and arts event changes
source_note: Original ForLanguage content informed by recurring music/arts club event-change themes in user-provided materials; no recalled prompt copied verbatim.

tasks.prompt: You have joined a music and arts club. Reply briefly to five member messages.
questions: What kind of music do you enjoy?
How often do you attend live events?
Who do you usually go with?

tasks.prompt: The club wants to organise a creative event for local families. Write a short message suggesting one activity.
Members are discussing how to attract more people to club events.
questions: Would a live performance or a practical workshop attract more people?
What is the best way to advertise a local arts event?
Should students receive cheaper tickets? Why or why not?

tasks.prompt: The club announces that several planned live events will be replaced by online sessions and a booking fee will apply to some workshops. Write to a friend about the changes.

Write a formal email to the arts club manager about the move to online sessions and the new booking fee. Explain your concerns and suggest a balanced plan that keeps some face-to-face activities affordable.
